title: Phase-IDENT: Identification of Two-phase PDEs with Uncertainty Quantification
summary: We propose a novel method, Phase-IDENT, for identifying partial differential equations (PDEs) from noisy observations of dynamical systems that exhibit phase transitions. Such phenomena are prevalent in fluid dynamics and materials science, where they can be modeled mathematically as functions satisfying different PDEs within distinct regions separated by phase boundaries. Our approach simultaneously identifies the underlying PDEs in each regime and accurately reconstructs the phase boundaries.
